fullPassage: To tantalize someone is to make them want something, often something they can never get. The word comes from the Greek myth of King Tantalus, who was so proud that he tried to fool the gods. When invited to eat with them, Tantalus stole their special food so that he could bring it to his friends. As a punishment, he was sent to the underworld. He had to stand in a pool of water with delicious ripe fruit hanging from a tree above him. Whenever he tried to drink the water, it would drain away. If he tried to pick the fruit, the branches would move out of reach. Tantalus was already in the underworld, so no matter how hungry or thirsty he got, he would never die.

questions.passage: To tantalize someone is to make them want something, often something they can never get. The word comes from the Greek myth of King Tantalus, who was so (A)[humble / proud] that he tried to fool the gods. When invited to eat with them, Tantalus stole their special food so that he could bring it to his friends. As a (B)[punishment / reward], he was sent to the underworld. He had to stand in a pool of water with (C)[disgusting / delicious] ripe fruit hanging from a tree above him. Whenever he tried to drink the water, it would drain away. If he tried to pick the fruit, the branches would move out of reach. Tantalus was already in the underworld, so no matter how hungry or thirsty he got, he would never die.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) proud=거만한 / humble=겸손한 (B) punishment=처벌 / reward=보상 (C) delicious=맛있는 / disgusting=역겨운
det.analysis:
① proud—punishment—delicious: 탄탈로스는 거만해서 신을 속이려 했고, 처벌로 저승에 보내졌으며, 맛있는 과일이 매달려 있었다 ←정답
② humble: 겸손했다면 신을 속이려 하지 않았을 것 — 문맥과 반대
③ reward/disgusting: 보상/역겨운은 처벌·맛있는 과일 문맥과 반대
④ humble/reward: 겸손한/보상은 모두 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 거만함(proud)→처벌(punishment), 그리고 맛있는(delicious) 과일이라는 흐름

det.korean: (A) stole=훔쳤다 / returned=돌려주었다 (B) ripe=익은 / rotten=썩은 (C) thirsty=목마른 / satisfied=만족한

③ stole—ripe—thirsty: 음식을 훔쳤고, 익은 과일이 매달려 있었으며, 아무리 목말라도 죽지 않았다 ←정답

det.tip: 훔침(stole)→익은(ripe) 과일→목마름(thirsty)의 형벌 흐름

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: invite(초대하다) → invited(과거분사). 주어(he)가 초대받는 수동 의미의 분사구문
det.analysis: invite를 과거분사 invited로 변환. 'When (he was) invited to eat'로 주어가 초대를 받는 수동 관계이므로 과거분사가 필요
det.tip: When _____ to eat → (주어가) 초대받는 수동 → 과거분사 invited

questions.passage: He had to stand in a pool of water with delicious ripe fruit __________ (hang) from a tree above him.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: hang(매달리다) → hanging(현재분사). 'with + 명사 + 분사' 구문에서 능동·진행의 현재분사
det.analysis: hang을 현재분사 hanging으로 변환. 'with delicious ripe fruit hanging from a tree'는 '과일이 매달린 채'라는 부대상황으로, 과일이 스스로 매달려 있는 능동 관계이므로 현재분사가 필요
det.tip: with + 명사 + _____ → 명사가 능동으로 '~한 채' → 현재분사 hanging

questions.passage: To tantalize someone is to make them want something, often something they can never get. The word comes from the Greek myth of King Tantalus, who was so proud that he tried to fool the gods. When invited to eat with them, Tantalus stole their special food so that he could bring it to his friends. As a punishment, he was sent to the underworld. He had to stand in a pool of water with delicious ripe fruit hanging from a tree above him. Whenever he tried to drink the water, it would __________. If he tried to pick the fruit, the branches would move out of reach. Tantalus was already in the underworld, so no matter how hungry or thirsty he got, he would never die.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: drain away=빠져나가다 / stay still=가만히 있다 / boil over=끓어 넘치다 / freeze solid=꽁꽁 얼다
det.analysis:
① drain away: 물을 마시려 할 때마다 물이 빠져나가 버렸다 ←정답
② stay still: 물이 가만히 있었다면 마실 수 있었을 것 — 형벌 맥락과 반대
③ boil over: 끓어 넘치다 — 문맥 부적절
④ freeze solid: 꽁꽁 얼다 — 문맥 부적절
det.tip: 마시려 하면 물이 사라지는 형벌 → drain away(빠져나가다)

questions.passage: To tantalize someone is to make them want something, often something they can never get. The word comes from the Greek myth of King Tantalus, who was so proud that he tried to fool the gods. When invited to eat with them, Tantalus stole their special food so that he could bring it to his friends. As a punishment, he was sent to the underworld. He had to stand in a pool of water with delicious ripe fruit hanging from a tree above him. Whenever he tried to drink the water, it would drain away. If he tried to pick the fruit, the branches would move __________. Tantalus was already in the underworld, so no matter how hungry or thirsty he got, he would never die.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: into place=제자리로 / toward him=그를 향해 / down low=아래 낮게 / out of reach=손이 닿지 않는 곳으로
det.analysis:
① into place: 제자리로 움직였다면 딸 수 있었을 것 — 형벌 맥락과 반대
② toward him: 그를 향해 움직이면 오히려 따기 쉬움 — 반대
③ down low: 아래로 낮게 오면 따기 쉬움 — 반대
④ out of reach: 과일을 따려 하면 가지가 손 닿지 않는 곳으로 물러났다 ←정답
det.tip: 따려 하면 가지가 멀어지는 형벌 → move out of reach(손 닿지 않는 곳으로)
